messages:
paul: Opening a small PR to clean up model-card guidance for bench reporting, add a short migration note for quant variants, and include a copyable perf-harness snippet. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1673 :wave:

amira: Thanks! Can you make the required fields explicit in the template? i.e. device, seq_len, batch, warmup_iters, quant, and whether numbers are "lab" vs "hosted".
\pyang: Also include a concise example of how to show delta between quant and fp16 (two-row example). Writers keep leaving that out.

paul: Yes 9 I'll add a tiny 2-row illustrative table in the template and link to the canonical model-catalog matrix for full data.

amira: Please include the exact perf-harness command we use and a short sample output block so folks can map fields.

paul: Example snippet I'll paste: 
```
# perf-harness example (copy-paste)
python perf_harness.py --model nebula3b --seq_len 1024 --batch 1 --iters 400 --device a100 --quant fp16 --collect p50,p95,tokens_per_s
# sample output: p50=18ms p95=34ms tokens_per_s=1300 (steady-state after warmup=50)
```

yang: For normalization, propose we show a short heuristic formula: norm_tps = measured_tps * (device_gflops / baseline_gflops). Mark as heuristic and include a worked example.

paul: Will do. Example I'll add: "normalize to a100: norm = 900 * (312/125) = 2246 (heuristic)" and a sentence: "Do not use for billing comparisons; use lab runs for canonical numbers."

amira: Call out quant caveats explicitly: "quant variants may reduce seq_limit and change memory pattern" and link to model-catalog's seq_limit anchor. Also add a one-liner recommending an eng-ml sanity check of any numbers.

paul: Adding those notes + reviewer checklist: eng-ml for numbers, eng-runtime for variant naming, docs for copyedit.

perf-bot: Automated: On PR open I will add labels docs and perf-needed (if numbers changed) and post the standard checklist.

paul: Also replacing stale perf links I found (old /perf/benchmarks) with https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness#readme and listing changed files in the PR description.

yang: One more nit: keep the model-card example compact; avoid pasting full matrices into the card. Link to the catalog instead.

amira: Agreed. 2-row example + link is enough. I'll do a quick editorial pass after eng-ml signs off.

paul: Thanks all. I'll tag reviewers in the PR now and add a CHANGENOTES entry if we update any canonical numbers. last_message_ts=3723457120
